notes: SSC GD Constable cutoffs work differently from other SSC exams: selection is **state/UT-wise and force-wise** (BSF, CISF, CRPF, ITBP, SSB, AR, SSF, NCB), so there is no single national cutoff. The rows below are the **official all-India male figures** from the CTGD 2024 result (the most recent cycle with a complete declared result) — treat them as the national benchmark; your state's cutoff can be higher or lower. Marks are out of 160 (CBT) and are **normalized** across shifts. Female cutoffs run lower than male in most states.
